thread:
jonathan_oncall: incident_bot just paged for sustained external-tool invoke spike on prod. p95 latency for /v1/generate jumped ~120ms -> ~1.2s, 5xxs climbing. Looks correlated with external-tool-proxy timeouts. Proposing temporary soft-cap on external integrations + restrict structured JSON output for non-enterprise tiers while we stabilize. opinions?

incident_bot: ALERT: external_tool_invokes_high [prod] 3470012345 - paging oncall (avg qps 2.3k -> 9.1k over 10m)

maria_ops: taking. oncall runbook: investigate top tenants, consider per-tenant throttles first.

raj_platform: grabbing tenant top list now. quick query returned top 8 tenants responsible for ~72% of these calls. preparing per-tenant action patch.

leila_support: if we cap or flip structured_output we'll need a short customer note. I can draft a banner and outreach to top 5 affected. please tag me when you know the tenant IDs.

raj_platform: recommended immediate actions (short):
```
# soft cap free/burst tenants external invokes
redwoodctl quota update --scope=free-tier --feature=external_tool_invokes --max-per-min=20
# per-tenant mitigation for top noisy tenants
redwoodctl quota update --tenant <TENANT_ID> --feature=external_tool_invokes --max-per-min=5
# disable structured JSON output for non-enterprise
redwoodctl feature flag set structured_output false --scope=non-enterprise
```

emma_devex: prefer disabling structured output first (less likely to increase compute) + route tool calls to sandbox proxy. That reduces KV/cache churn.

sre_bot: metrics -> https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/5432/tool-invoke?orgId=1 (p95, 5xx, queue length). currently queue backlog up 4s.

maria_ops: agreed plan: 1) flip structured_output=false for non-enterprise (global) 2) apply free-tier soft cap 3) per-tenant 5/min on the top 8 noisy tenants 4) monitor 15m and adjust. I'll own the rollout.

jonathan_oncall: +1. Maria, after flip can you post the exact commands in this thread so support can copy for comms? Also add rollback commands.

maria_ops: posting now. rollback is just setting structured_output true and removing tenant caps.
```
# disable structured output for non-enterprise
redwoodctl feature flag set structured_output false --scope=non-enterprise --reason="live-mitigation-3470012345"
# soft cap free-tier
redwoodctl quota update --scope=free-tier --feature=external_tool_invokes --max-per-min=20 --reason="live-mitigation-3470012345"
# tighten tenant-specific caps
redwoodctl quota update --tenant tenant-123 --feature=external_tool_invokes --max-per-min=5 --reason="live-mitigation-3470012345"
# rollback example
redwoodctl feature flag set structured_output true --scope=non-enterprise --reason="rollback-3470012345"
redwoodctl quota delete --tenant tenant-123 --feature=external_tool_invokes --reason="rollback-3470012345"
```

leila_support: copied. drafting customer banner: short + link to status page. tagging top 5 owners for direct email.

raj_platform: applied per-tenant caps to first 4 noisy tenants. seeing immediate drop in external proxy errors for those tenant sessions.

sre_bot: after changes: p95 down to ~350ms, 5xx rate decreased 60% for capped tenants. queue backlog reduced to ~800ms.

maria_ops: monitoring. next check in 15m, will escalate to oncall lead if not stable. leaving note for followup actions: review auto-scaling thresholds for external-tool-proxy + consider graceful degrade path that returns text-only fallback.

jonathan_oncall: thanks team. tag me if any customer escalations. moving to watch state. :eyes:
